title: MyPortfolio
description: MyPortfolio is a web application built with React and Vite, entirely driven by JSON files (no hard-coded content). The site is bilingual French/English, with a light/dark theme, accessible detail modals and a contact form connected to EmailJS. This very website, which you are currently browsing, is the result of this personal project, designed to showcase my skills, my projects and my academic and professional background in a clear, interactive and accessible way.

title: Road Accidents France Visualization
description: This R Shiny application makes it possible to explore and analyse road accident data in France between 2005 and 2016. It offers several visualisations and features to better understand the trends and factors related to road accidents.

title: Rennes Mobility Visualization
description: This small project offers an interactive visualisation of mobility in Rennes using the Bokeh library in Python. The project focuses on two main aspects: the STAR public transport network and the usage of soft modes of transport (cycling/pedestrian) on the main boulevards.
